q1_what_did_you_play: I played Bag of Tricks on Shrinker Beetle, taking the option to spend 3 Sparks and place 3 Bombs dealing 5. Then I played Spirited Away for 12 Block, and Run Away! for 4 Block. This used all 2 Energy and all 3 Sparks, leaving 16 Block and placing 3 Bombs on the enemy.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing Bag of Tricks with the free option to place only 1 Bomb dealing 5, then Spirited Away and Run Away!. That line would preserve more Spark if the bombs do not immediately return it, but it deals 10 less damage this turn for no immediate benefit against a debuff intent.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up the Spark bank that would remain if I had taken the free 1-Bomb option. It also committed all available Spark to the 3-Bomb option, so if those Bombs do not detonate and return Spark this turn, the turn ends with no Spark bank. It also spent Energy on Block even though the telegraphed enemy action is a Debuff rather than an attack.
q4_different_intent: No. The enemy’s telegraphed intent is to apply a Debuff, not to attack. A different intent would not change the core arithmetic: the 3-Bomb option still deals more damage this turn, and the available Energy still allows the same Block package. If the intent were a large attack, the Block would be more clearly valuable, but the same line would still be playable and likely preferred.
